tasks.label: Project: Stop local services
args: $ports = 8000,8001,5173,5174,5175,19000,19001,19530; $stopped = @(); foreach ($p in $ports) { $conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach ($c in $conns) { $pid = $c.OwningProcess; if ($pid -and ($stopped -notcontains $pid)) { try { Stop-Process -Id $pid -Force -ErrorAction Stop; $stopped += $pid; Write-Output \"stopped_pid=$pid port=$p\" } catch { Write-Output \"failed_pid=$pid port=$p reason=$($_.Exception.Message)\" } } } }; if (-not $stopped.Count) { Write-Output \"no_listening_process_found\" }

tasks.label: Project: Stop local services (retry)
args: $ports = 8000,8001,5173,5174,5175,19000,19001,19530; $stopped = @(); foreach ($p in $ports) { $conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach ($c in $conns) { $procId = $c.OwningProcess; if ($procId -and ($stopped -notcontains $procId)) { try { Stop-Process -Id $procId -Force -ErrorAction Stop; $stopped += $procId; Write-Output \"stopped_pid=$procId port=$p\" } catch { Write-Output \"failed_pid=$procId port=$p reason=$($_.Exception.Message)\" } } } }; if (-not $stopped.Count) { Write-Output \"no_listening_process_found\" }

tasks.label: Project: Docker down all
args: Set-Location "d:\Graduation-Project"; docker compose -f docker-compose.yml down; docker compose -f docker-compose.monitoring.yml down; if (Test-Path "docker-compose.prod.yml") { docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml down }

tasks.label: Project: Verify listening ports
tasks.command: $ports = 8000,8001,5173,5174,5175,19000,19001,19530; $results = @(); foreach ($p in $ports) { $conns = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($conns) { foreach ($c in $conns) { $proc = Get-Process -Id $c.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $name = if ($proc) { $proc.ProcessName } else { 'unknown' }; $results += ('port={0} pid={1} name={2}' -f $p, $c.OwningProcess, $name) } } }; if ($results.Count -eq 0) { Write-Output 'all_target_ports_free' } else { $results | ForEach-Object { Write-Output $_ } }

tasks.label: Project: Verify ports final
tasks.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { @(8000,8001,5173,5174,5175,19000,19001,19530) -contains $_.LocalPort } | Select-Object LocalPort,OwningProcess | Sort-Object LocalPort | Format-Table -HideTableHeaders

tasks.label: Project: Verify ports after kill
tasks.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { @(8000,8001,5173,5174,5175,19000,19001,19530) -contains $_.LocalPort } | Select-Object LocalPort,OwningProcess | Sort-Object LocalPort | Format-Table -HideTableHeaders

tasks.label: Project: Inspect port 8000
tasks.command: $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 8000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($c) { $c | Format-List LocalAddress,LocalPort,State,OwningProcess; try { Get-Process -Id $c[0].OwningProcess | Format-List Id,ProcessName,Path } catch { Write-Output "process_lookup_failed" } } else { Write-Output "port_8000_not_listening" }

tasks.label: Project: Kill related processes
tasks.command: $procs = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -and ( $_.CommandLine -match 'Graduation-Project' -or $_.CommandLine -match 'uvicorn' -or $_.CommandLine -match 'vite' -or $_.CommandLine -match 'rag_qa\web\backend' -or $_.CommandLine -match 'rag_qa\web\frontend') }; if (-not $procs) { Write-Output 'no_related_processes' } else { $ids = $procs | Select-Object -ExpandProperty ProcessId -Unique; foreach ($id in $ids) { try { Stop-Process -Id $id -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output "stopped_pid=$id" } catch { Write-Output "failed_pid=$id" } } }

tasks.label: Project: Final port check 2
tasks.command: $lines = netstat -ano | Select-String ':8000|:8001|:5173|:5174|:5175|:19000|:19001|:19530' | Select-String 'LISTENING'; if ($lines) { $lines | ForEach-Object { $_.Line } } else { Write-Output 'all_target_ports_free' }
